all_qualifying_join_path_SQL:
SELECT r.node_id AS resolution_node,r.resolutionId,
 t.node_id AS tdoc_node,t.tdocNumber,s.node_id AS spec_node,s.specNumber AS spec,
 co.node_id AS company_node,co.companyName AS company FROM Resolution r JOIN rel_REFERENCES rr ON rr.src_id=r.node_id
 JOIN Tdoc t ON t.node_id=rr.dst_id JOIN rel_MODIFIES mm ON mm.src_id=t.node_id
 JOIN Spec s ON s.node_id=mm.dst_id JOIN rel_SUBMITTED_BY sb ON sb.src_id=t.node_id
 JOIN Company co ON co.node_id=sb.dst_id
 WHERE instr((CASE WHEN instr(coalesce(r.content,''),char(10)||'Decision:')=0 THEN coalesce(r.content,'') ELSE substr(r.content,1,instr(r.content,char(10)||'Decision:')-1) END),t.tdocNumber)>0
 ORDER BY spec,company,t.node_id,r.node_id
group_SQL:
SELECT s.specNumber AS spec,co.companyName AS company,
 count(DISTINCT t.node_id) AS tdoc_count FROM Resolution r JOIN rel_REFERENCES rr ON rr.src_id=r.node_id
 JOIN Tdoc t ON t.node_id=rr.dst_id JOIN rel_MODIFIES mm ON mm.src_id=t.node_id
 JOIN Spec s ON s.node_id=mm.dst_id JOIN rel_SUBMITTED_BY sb ON sb.src_id=t.node_id
 JOIN Company co ON co.node_id=sb.dst_id
 WHERE instr((CASE WHEN instr(coalesce(r.content,''),char(10)||'Decision:')=0 THEN coalesce(r.content,'') ELSE substr(r.content,1,instr(r.content,char(10)||'Decision:')-1) END),t.tdocNumber)>0
 GROUP BY s.specNumber,co.companyName
 ORDER BY s.specNumber,tdoc_count DESC,co.companyName
projection: Group by spec; preserve count DESC, company ASC SQL order; take first ten company names per spec.
